# agentic-mail

Send mail via transactional plus cold vendors.

Keywords: email, resend, cold-email, agentic-suite, claude-code, codex, cli, mcp.

- SDK: import { sendMail } from "agentic-mail".
- CLI: agentic-mail send --from "..." --to "..." --subject "..." --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-mail mcp, then call send_mail.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-mail
